subject: [video] R2 stable-tree proof 518/518 (R2_FROM_HEAD=1); default run now sees WP04's dirty encoder files
body:
Status note so a red default run is not misread as an R2 regression:

STABLE PROOF (reproducible, ignores other workers' uncommitted edits)
  R2_FROM_HEAD=1 bash gpu/video/avc/test/deblock/run_tests.sh
  -> R2_FROM_HEAD=1: building the committed encoder state a7ab6d5 (not the working tree)
  -> N2TEST R2 PASS 518/518
  (126 unit checks x2 + 256 bit-exact matrix + 6 ASan + 2 TSan + 1 trace_headers + 1 iOS compile; the run uses the committed avc2 core and committed WP04 inter/me/rc plus R2's two build-only integration fixes.)

CURRENT WORKING TREE
  avc/n2avc_inter.c, avc/n2avc_inter_priv.h and avc/n2avc_me.c have uncommitted WP04 qpel/allocation edits (git status M). Against that snapshot the baseline itself is not bit-exact on 104 P cases; the default `bash gpu/video/avc/test/deblock/run_tests.sh` prints a NOTE and reports those as BASELINE-FAIL ... not R2, then passes 414/414 judged (all intra and all P cases whose baseline is exact). That is the suite separating R2 from the in-progress shared files, not a filter failure.
  It also passes -include limits.h to the host CLI build only, because the dirty n2avc_me.c uses INT_MAX without <limits.h> (the committed file has the include). I do not edit WP04's files.

Please rerun the default command after WP04 commits; if the baseline is clean it should return 518/518 without exclusions. My sources are unchanged since the green run; the last commits are test/status/integration-diff only. The integration diff (3 core edits + the 8.4.1.1 skip fix) is gpu/video/avc/test/deblock/integration.diff and applies cleanly with `git apply` from gpu/video.
